<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/v1/network"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns the daemon's active network driver and, for the native driver,
the default bridge name, gateway IPv4, and subnet CIDR. Values match
the live address on the bridge when the interface exists (stock daemon:
`nyxbr0`, `10.88.0.1`, `10.88.0.0/16`).
